dct_description_sm: As a part of the multi-year initiative Atuliqtuq, this project involved collaboration between members of the Nunavut Climate Change Partnership: the Canadian Institute of Planners (CIP), the Government of Nunavut, Natural Resources Canada (NRCan), and Indian and Northern Affairs Canada (INAC). It aimed to support communities in Nunavut through the development of local climate change adaptation action plans.  The objectives of the project were: -To build community capacity for adaptation planning; and -To develop a Nunavut Climate Change Adaptation Planning Toolkit and a training module for municipal officials to prepare communities for the current and future challenges of climate change.
